faq.deskripsi: Frequently asked questions about LMS access
faq.a1: Visit the LMS login page, enter your NIM/NIP and registered password. If you don't have an account, contact the academic administration.
faq.a2: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, follow the reset instructions sent to your registered email.
faq.a3: Make sure your internet connection is stable and your browser is up to date. If problems persist, contact IT helpdesk.
faq.q4: My account is locked, how do I unlock it?
faq.a4: Accounts are usually locked after several failed login attempts. Wait a moment and try again, or contact the IT helpdesk to unlock your account.
faq.bantuanDeskripsi: Our support team is ready to help you resolve LMS access issues.
